messages:
maya: opened PR #764 to add streaming SDK example. local mkdocs preview looks fine but the Netlify/Vercel preview is serving 404s for images and some code blocks show as one long line. any ideas?
ben: can you paste the preview URL?
maya: https://deploy-preview-764--docs.redwood.example.com — assets/GettingStarted.png -> 404
docs-bot: Deploy preview for PR #764 finished (status: success). build log: warnings: 2, errors: 0.
luke: quick guess: check base_url/site_url in mkdocs.yml. Netlify often serves from a subpath (e.g., /docs/) which can break absolute asset paths.
elaine: also check for mac vs linux filename casing. I hit this before where GettingStarted.png worked locally on mac but 404ed on Netlify (linux fs is case-sensitive).
sam: for the one-long-line code blocks, sometimes a mismatched markdown fence (```python vs ```) or a trailing tab char causes the renderer to collapse lines. did you run mkdocs build locally to inspect the HTML?
maya: ran `mkdocs serve` and `mkdocs build` — both produced correct HTML and assets in site/. so puzzling. file names match on my machine.
ben: compare the built site/ tree with the preview artifacts. Netlify may rewrite paths if `site_url` is set. also check `extra_javascript` or plugins that post-process assets.
maya: I dumped the site/ tree and noticed `site/assets/GettingStarted.abcd1234.png` on my machine and preview shows request to `/assets/GettingStarted.png` (missing hash). maybe the preview is stripping hashes?
docs-bot: Netlify build log (excerpt): "Copying files to deploy directory... Found 1,234 files." No obvious rewriting step.
luke: if the preview is requesting unhashed names, double-check if you're referencing images as `/assets/GettingStarted.png` (absolute) vs `assets/GettingStarted.png` (relative). With a base_url set to `/docs/` absolute paths jump out of that. Prefer relative links: `![alt](./assets/GettingStarted.png)`.
elaine: additional gotcha: when you set `use_directory_urls: false` it changes how links are emitted. Not usually related to images but worth verifying.
ben: here's a quick local checklist to reproduce the preview environment:
```
pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material
mkdocs build -d /tmp/site
# serve the built site on a path so you can simulate /docs/
python3 -m http.server --directory /tmp/site 8000
# then curl http://localhost:8000/assets/GettingStarted.png (should be 200)
```
If that returns 404, the problem is in the build. If 200, the issue is in the preview host config.
maya: ran that and curl returned 200 locally when serving from /tmp/site. so build contains the file.
sam: another angle — our Netlify config uses `publish: site` but the preview container might set a different root. Check `netlify.toml` and the preview logs for "Publish directory" line.
maya: netlify.toml has `publish = "site"`. preview logs show Publish directory: site.
ben: hmmm. Are there any CDN redirects or rewrites? Vercel sometimes rewrites requests for certain patterns. If you can share the failing request/response headers from the preview network tab that'd help.
maya: posted screenshot (link). Response has 404, request URL is https://deploy-preview.../assets/GettingStarted.png. Response body: HTML 404 page (Netlify default).
luke: could be a race where hashed asset wasn't uploaded due to transient build caching — try clearing the cache or pushing an empty commit to force rebuild.
maya: pushed a small whitespace change to the image path (switch to relative `./assets/gettingstarted.png`) and also normalized the filename to lowercase. repushed.
docs-bot: Deploy preview for PR #764 started.
ben: also add a short note in the PR description about the mkdocs/Netlify mismatch and include the local reproduce steps so reviewers can verify quickly.
elaine: regarding approvals — do we want to merge this during the usual docs merge window (12:30–13:30 PST) so it doesn't block other previews?
sam: I'll review in ~30m. if CI and preview are green I'll approve and merge in the 12:30 window.
maya: thanks — one more request: could someone add a tiny note to CONTRIBUTING.md about filename casing and preview hosts?\en: (reaction) :thumbsup:
ben: quick snippet to add to CONTRIBUTING.md for local preview tips:
```
# Local preview tips
- Use `mkdocs serve` for quick iteration.
- To emulate a subpath (e.g. `/docs/`) run `python -m http.server --directory site 8000` after `mkdocs build` and open `http://localhost:8000/docs/`.
- If images 404 in CI but work locally, check filename casing and use relative paths: `![alt](./assets/your-image.png)`.
- If previews show unhashed asset names, try clearing preview cache or forcing a rebuild on the host.
```
maya: added the CONTRIBUTING.md change to the PR and pushed. preview is green so far. last ask: who can click approve?
sam: I'll do the review in 15 and approve if green.
maya: awesome — thanks everyone :)
